description: Harness-agnostic hook wiring: event -> handler script. Handlers read a JSON event on stdin, write messages to stderr, and exit 0 (allow) or 2 (block). sync-harnesses.js translates this file into each harness's native hook configuration. The match globs start with ** because a workspace is any directory holding project.yaml, whatever its name; each handler resolves the workspace root by that marker and ignores files outside one.

hooks.description: Block overwriting approved reference assets, existing page and cover renders, and existing edition exports; create the next version instead.
Validate schema-known workspace artifacts against their schema after every write.
After a page.yaml write, run the panel ledger audit for its issue and warn about findings on that page.
Block generate-assets --live without an explicit --yes confirmation.
